source_requirement: Deprecated sound annotations retain activation and icon behavior.
assertion_review: The public URL test asserts the same literal handoff from an annotation and an action. The sample test checks decoded signed-PCM rebiasing and mu-law RIFF bytes. Existing appearance review owns the icon assertions.
limits: File handoff is scoped product behavior. No actual player, sound decoding quality or artwork certificate.

source_requirement: Movie activation uses its activation entry; false prevents playback.
assertion_review: The public activation test checks the exact embedded payload and title/unsupported-Mode note. The A=false control hands nothing over. A separate test exercises the click route.
limits: Playback excluded. SuppliedAP/poster appearance remains separate; no complete activation-parameter matrix claimed.

source_requirement: A Screen without AP has no default appearance or printing. A rendition requires P to reference a valid page and that page to list the annotation.
assertion_review: The existing no-appearance test covers model appearance. The public missing-Annots control checks no Media event and the corresponding diagnostic. Primary page513/498 explicitly states both preconditions.
limits: D40: the ledger still calls rendition actions out of scope and the P duty vacated, although current12.6.4.14 is implemented. Precondition/script follow-up is separate; D35 owns the earlier appearance-comment issue.

source_requirement: A sound action references its sound stream; playback parameters are distinct from the sound bytes.
assertion_review: Public URL and filtered-sample tests inspect actual Media events, literal bytes and the Repeat diagnostic. A private-CO control withholds media and names the unsupported codec.
limits: Handoff only; repeat/mix/volume/synchronous playback not implemented or certified.

source_requirement: A movie action selects an annotation or title and operation. Its settings override annotation activation defaults.
assertion_review: The intro-title Play control hands over the movie even when annotation A=false. The missing outro title has no Media event and a diagnostic. Stop, Pause and Resume each hand nothing over and report that nothing plays in this program. The restrictions-On control admits the movie without rendition-only permissions.
limits: Action-chain page selection and all overrides not recertified here. Actual movieplayer excluded.

source_requirement: Before executing a rendition action, check Screen P and Annots membership. JS executes first; OP is the fallback when the processor cannot execute ECMAScript.
assertion_review: Public positive control checks the exact moov payload, video/mp4 type and title. Missing Annots has no Media event. TEMPNEVER with restrictions On refuses; TEMPALWAYS hands over; Ask requires an answer. The unplaced code checks Type=Page and Annots.
limits: The tiny moov payload does not establish a playable container. Enabled script priority and detached-page membership are separate live follow-ups. No complete precondition certificate.

source_requirement: RichMediaExecute invokes the specified rich-media annotation handler command.
assertion_review: The current exclusion concerns this handler and playback. It is distinct from the generic document/viewer JavaScript action.
limits: Retain excludedhandler scope; a general claim that all script execution is excluded is stale. No handlerexecution test is demanded by current scope.

source_requirement: The introduction describes embedding and playing multimedia; operational rules reside in child clauses.
assertion_review: Current CLAUDE.md and ADR1946 distinguish playback/3D rendering from admitted still appearances, viability, extraction and file handoff.
limits: Outofscopeintro cannot be used to exclude those admitted child features. No independent headingalgorithm to test.

source_requirement: The Renditions heading introduces common, media and selector child clauses.
assertion_review: Specific tests cover C/P/SP viability and selector order. There is no independent heading algorithm.
limits: Passing chosenclip is not full media-player support.

source_requirement: Media rendition viability is the conjunction of C, P and SP viability. Omitting C requires a player that takes no input, referenced through P.PL.MU or A.
assertion_review: The public model control admits best-effort options, rejects a must-honour screen option, and rejects missing C with a named inputless player. Walk::media_rendition accumulates play/screen failures before accepting the clip.
limits: Sampled conjunction branches; actualexternalplayer has no softwareidentity. Tests do not prove everydefaultcombination.

source_requirement: The Media clip objects heading introduces data and section children.
assertion_review: Existing section tests check next-level viability, nesting, required-seek rejection and best-effort continuation. Detailed owners review container semantics.

source_requirement: An unrecognized clip subtype is expressly nonviable.
assertion_review: The MCX test asserts false; MCD positive controls exist separately. Parent inspected Walk::clip dispatch.
limits: OptionalTypeproducerconstraint does not create a general readerrejectobligation.

source_requirement: Must-honour and best-effort screen parameters govern viability. Playing clips must stop when their document closes.
assertion_review: The model test distinguishes best-effort W=1/M=2, which is viable, from must-honour W=3, which is not. File-only handoff cannot request the specified window.
limits: No playbackwindow or lifecycleengine is implemented. Do not call externalplayerstoponclose tested; current scope excludes that engine.

source_requirement: Software identifiers describe name, version and OS. Child clauses define matching and partial-recognition viability.
assertion_review: The player test admits NU/A and empty MU, rejects nonempty MU, and rejects unknown content type without MU. software_identifier_set_aside checks unknown keys, missing U and negative versions.
limits: ADR2376 defines neither the processor nor its handoff player with a software name. URI escaping/case, OS and version-range comparison are absent and not certified. Reopen when the host supplies an identity; preserve the earlier multimedia-data qualification.
